dedupe_keys.name: carta di pericolosita sismica locale vettoriale della regione umbria

description: Carta di pericolosità sismica locale vettoriale della Regione Umbria is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by storicizzati.territorio.regione.umbria.it. Local seismic hazard card vector in scale 1:10,000 of the Umbria Region. The information levels displayed in the form of points, lines and polygons represent: areas not susceptible to amplification and deformation, areas susceptible to seismic amplification by morphological or stratigraphic causes, areas susceptible to co-seismic deformations (breaks, liquefactions, active faults, thickenings). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Local seismic hazard card vector of the Umbria Region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Pericolosità sismica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
